block.curation_note: Manual reference-genus correspondence for the preserved NCBITaxon:1472881 Terrabacter sp. 2APm3 stock. PMID:42598292 Methods identifies DSMZ 28514; DSMZ BacDive 157986 links DSM 28514 to 2APm3. NCBI Taxonomy 1472881 LineageEx verifies genus 53355 Terrabacter; the old 37948 ancestor assertion was incorrect. The native exact stock ID/name lookup returns no result on the retained crosswalk bytes. A separately inspected native genus 53355 query gives the stored genus lineage and 12/12 reference-genome counts after named-species filtering (18 raw genus rows were inspected). This does not establish an exact stock genome, GTDB species assignment, or 12 strains of 2APm3. Preserve this evidenced manual ancestor mapping rather than relabel the stock or invent exact-genome support. Issue #2849.
